name: Margherita Pizza
description: Classic pizza with fresh mozzarella, basil, and San Marzano tomato sauce on a hand-tossed crust.

name: Classic Cheeseburger
description: Juicy beef patty with melted cheddar, crisp lettuce, tomato, and house sauce on a brioche bun. Served with fries.

name: Salmon Sushi Roll
description: Fresh salmon and avocado wrapped in seasoned rice and nori. Served with wasabi and pickled ginger.

name: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Al dente spaghetti in a creamy egg and Pecorino Romano sauce with crispy pancetta and black pepper.

name: Grilled Chicken Salad
description: Fresh greens, grilled chicken breast, cherry tomatoes, cucumbers, and balsamic vinaigrette.

name: Chocolate Lava Cake
description: Warm chocolate cake with a molten center, served with vanilla bean ice cream and fresh berries.

name: Crispy Chicken Wings
description: Eight crispy fried chicken wings tossed in your choice of buffalo, BBQ, or garlic parmesan sauce.

name: Pad Thai Noodles
description: Stir-fried rice noodles with shrimp, bean sprouts, scrambled egg, and tamarind sauce, garnished with peanuts.
